mapper.insert: insert into sys_staff_amount (staff_id, total_income, settle_amount, pending_amount, withdraw_amount, freeze_amount, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) values (#{staffId}, #{income}, 0.00, #{income}, 0.00, 0.00, now(), now(), 0) on duplicate key update total_income = total_income + #{income}, pending_amount = pending_amount + #{income}, is_deleted = 0, update_time = now()
mapper.update: update sys_staff_amount set pending_amount = pending_amount - #{amount}, settle_amount = settle_amount + #{amount}, update_time = now() where staff_id = #{staffId} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select a.*, s.account as staff_account, s.username as staff_name from sys_staff_amount a join sys_staff s on s.id = a.staff_id where a.staff_id = #{staffId} and a.is_deleted = 0 limit 1
select a.*, s.account as staff_account, s.username as staff_name from sys_staff_amount a join sys_staff s on s.id = a.staff_id where s.account = #{staffAccount} and a.is_deleted = 0 limit 1
select count(*) from sys_staff_amount a join sys_staff s on s.id = a.staff_id where a.is_deleted = 0
select id from sys_staff where account = #{account} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
select id, order_no, user_account, staff_account, order_amount, order_status, pay_status, is_deleted from homemaking_order where order_no = #{orderNo} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
